title: Phase A 2/8: hook draws the lead, the section blocks and the unheaded stream; filters chunk pages; section front findings panel
description:
Phase A, step 2. web/hooks.py draws the anatomy in the epic's design note from the markup step 1 generates. Pinned engine 5.92.0; no engine change. Replace `_group_references` + `_untagged_lists` in `page_finish` with one `_reference_list_page(html, page, resolve)` called at the same point (before `STOCK_TILE.sub`). Delete: UNTAGGED_LIST, UNTAGGED_LIST_ID, NOT_IN_A_SECTION, UNSECTIONED_REFERENCE_LABELS, `_without_sectioned`, `_untagged_lists` and the "All " / "Not in a section yet" headings. Keep REFERENCES_SHOWN, `_ranked_references`, `_references_by_section`, `_reference_row_sizes`, `_reference_rows_html`, `_section_videos`, MORE_LINKS. New constants and helpers (names are the spec; long descriptive names, no comments except for the concept): - `LEAD_MARK = re.compile(r'')`; `STREAM_REGION = re.compile(r'(
]*>)\s*(.*?)(\s*
)', re.S)`; `LIST_KIND = re.compile(r'data-list-kind="(videos|findings)"')`; `SOURCE_COUNT = re.compile(r'data-source-count="(\d+)"')`; `MEDIUM_CHIP = re.compile(r'')` (the engine prints it on mixed-media lists only, and video is the only medium); `STREAM_GRID = re.compile(r'(
    ]*data-reference-grid[^>]*>)(.*?)(
)', re.S)`; `CHUNK_PATH = re.compile(r'^/reference-lists/(?P[^/]+)/(?P[^/]+)/')`. - `_is_filed(tile, resolve) -> bool`: the tile has a section chip (SECTION_CHIP) and `resolve(chip text)` is not None. A section with no page is not filed. - `_is_video(tile) -> bool`: MEDIUM_CHIP in the tile. - `_keeps(list_kind, is_overview) -> Callable[[str], bool]`: on the overview pages (/videos/, /findings/) drop filed tiles; on any findings list also drop videos. - `_filtered_items(markup, keep)`: LIST_TILE_ITEM.sub keeping only `
  • ` whose tile passes `keep` (works for `
  • `). - Chunk pages (`page.kind == "reference_list"`): from CHUNK_PATH: page "videos" or "findings" with list "untagged" -> overview rules for that kind; page ending "--findings" (a section's findings list) -> drop videos; anything else unchanged. Return `_filtered_items(html, keep)`. - `_lead_row_sizes(count)`: 0 -> [], 1 -> [1], 2 -> [2], 3 -> [3], 4 -> [1, 3]. - `_reference_list_page(html, page, resolve)`: does nothing unless LIST_KIND matches (or the chunk-page branch applies). Steps: 1. Read list kind; overview = the page has `mom-by-section`. 2. Section blocks (overview only): from the BY_SECTION source, drop videos when kind is findings, keep only filed tiles, group with `_references_by_section`, then draw with `_reference_section(rank, label, references, noun, list_href, lead_present)`. Record whether the source proves there is nothing unfiled: tile count < data-source-count and no source tile passes the stream's keep rule. 3. Stream: filter its first-page items with the keep rule; take the first N kept `
  • ` (N from LEAD_MARK) out of the stream grid; draw them at LEAD_MARK as `
    ` + `_reference_rows_html(cards, _lead_row_sizes(len(cards)))` (the cards keep their stock tile markup; the later STOCK_TILE pass redraws them). No heading. Remove LEAD_MARK when there is no lead. 4. Remove the whole stream region when (a) its grid is empty and it has no `data-reference-more`, unless it holds `home-page-empty` and the page has no lead and no block (then keep the empty sentence); or (b) step 2 proved there is nothing unfiled. Otherwise keep the region with no heading. Order: compute `lead_present` from step 3 before drawing step 2's blocks (tiers depend on it); the output order in the page stays page-top, lead, blocks, stream. - `_reference_section(...)` changes: tier = `_story_tier(rank + (1 if lead_present else 0))`; the head's title links to `list_href(label)` = the section page address from `resolve` + "videos/" or "findings/"; no `papyrus-group-more` count span; the More link is `

    More <noun>…</a></p>` (noun "videos" / "findings") shown only when len(references) > shown. Add `_more_list_link(title, noun, href)` for it. - Section front findings panel: `SECTION_FINDINGS = re.compile(r'<!--sf:findings:(\d+)-->(.*?)<!--/sf:findings-->', re.S)` and `_section_findings(found, section_id)` called from `_section_front` next to SECTION_VIDEOS: keep non-video tiles; none -> return ""; otherwise `<div class="mom-section-head"><h2 class="mom-section-title"><a class="mom-section-title-link" href="/<id>/findings/">Findings</a></h2></div>` + one `_reference_rows_html` row of the first `shown` (data-count = how many) + `<p class="mom-more"><a class="mom-more-link" href="/<id>/findings/">More findings…</a></p>` when a further non-video tile exists. Unit tests: new tests/test_reference_lists.py with HTML snippets (stock tiles with and without section chips, medium chips, `<li data-key>`), covering: filed vs page-less section; video drop on findings only; lead lift of 0/1/2/3/4/5 kept items and the rows; the lifted cards are gone from the stream grid; stream removed when empty with no more control; kept with Load more; removed when the source proves nothing unfiled; tiers with and without a lead; More link text and href; chunk-page filtering per path; findings panel with 0, 2, 3 and 4+ non-video tiles. Acceptance: `python3 -m pytest tests/` passes; `python3 tools/preview_local.py /tmp/mom-out` projects; /videos/ in the fixture output contains no "All videos" and no "Not in a section yet"; the features task's scenarios pass.
